description: This file defines classes and structures related to application lifecycle management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes definitions for application launch and kill parameters, as well as the ApplicationContext class that manages application state, lifecycle, and related synchronization primitives.

classes.name: ApplicationLaunchParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for launching an application, including app ID, intent, arguments, target lifecycle state, and runtime configuration.

classes.name: ApplicationKillParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for killing an application, including a force flag.

classes.name: ApplicationContext
classes.description: Manages the state and lifecycle of an application, including session IDs, intents, state transitions, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: ApplicationContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing ApplicationContext with a given application ID.

methods.name: setLastLifecycleStateChangeTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last lifecycle state change.

methods.name: getLastLifecycleStateChangeTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last lifecycle state change.

methods.name: getStateChangeId
methods.description: Returns the current state change ID.
